# Removing mailWindow1 makes stylesheet loading explicit without proving cascade equivalence

The original removal replaces the wrapper link with four direct stylesheet links and relocates shared and platform rules into their receiving stylesheets. The platform package maps retain other destination-to-source values while the wrapper registrations disappear. Selected moved blocks match exactly, but their new load position and the deleted messengerBox background rules prevent a whole-cascade equivalence claim. The fixed accepted head later omits folderPane.css, and Windows selectors/theme values also have later changes. Keep the original move, later source and historical reviewers' visual reports separate.

Scope: Main mail-window stylesheet loading and platform skin packaging.
